results: Switching order preserves recipient-specific edits and updates the first recipient.
All three reviews unlock start; editing a reviewed message invalidates its review.
Starting opens tracking and prevents the launched sequence from being edited.
Consent proceeds in two stages, with a separate final-send pending state before Introduced.
Declining stops the sequence and retains the private note for the sender.
Tracking filters and search work; cancelling preserves prior acceptance history.
No horizontal overflow across setup, mobile invitation, tracking, and email views at 320, 390, 740, 1024, and 1440 px.
Three complete composers remain visible; horizontal stage selection focuses its matching composer.
Switching order preserves recipient-specific edits and updates send conditions.
Message edits invalidate only that review; address edits invalidate its request and the final introduction.
Per-message preview and the public-page preview follow edits and recipient order.
Invalid and duplicate addresses block launch; reviewed drafts launch into tracking and then become read-only.
Setup fits 320, 390, 650, 740, 1024, and 1440 px with all draft text visible and no horizontal overflow.
